harness.name: Zack AI Scanner
harness.description: Burp Suite extension that runs an LLM pipeline against one request and sends the real payloads.

uses.quote: Point it at a request (Proxy history, Repeater, Target) and pick either a specific vulnerability type or **AI Smart Scan** to let the model decide.
The extension then runs a staged LLM pipeline against that one request, sends real payloads through Burp, and reports what the evidence supports.
